note: Scripted by actors. No real person or data. UK chemist counter; strength and dosing said as words in separate segments; the listener asks for a repeat; things to avoid never mentioned.

segments.text: Right, this is the nitrofurantoin your GP sent over, fifty milligram capsules.
Take one capsule every six hours, with food, for three days.
Sorry, was that every six hours?
Yes, that's right, every six hours.
Side effects can include feeling sick or a headache, and your wee may look darker.
If you forget to take a capsule, take it when you remember, unless it's nearly time for the next one.
Keep them in the box at room temperature, out of the reach of children.
